## Important info

This will clash with any custom skin that modifies Eclipse Eternal Aspect Diana. You must own the skin and choose it in champ select.

## Description

**Author**: Suriin

**Skin**: Eclipse Eternal Aspect Diana

Makes it so the ult transformation lasts until death with the ability to toggle freely at any time.
